archive_provenance_note: First-pass cached archives were scanned with the unmodified d40ecf0 scanner before the candidate exact-fixture acknowledgment was added. Per-archive source hashes and original scan window are retained. No token-shape hits occurred in the new hosted delta.
cache_note: Archive records with archive_scan_window preserve first-pass downloaded fingerprints and findings; exact run metadata or immutable artifact ID was revalidated during this final inventory.
coverage_limits: Delta review of GitHub REST-visible bodies, comments, reviews, Actions logs, artifacts, releases, release assets, and recognized attachment links. Hidden refs, deleted records, edit histories, commit identities, check annotations and summaries beyond logs, external linked content, and unchanged historical media remain outside exhaustive coverage. This snapshot cannot cover later changes. The nine new local-path occurrences were removed from current PR bodies only; their edit histories remain outside inspected coverage.
method: Exact content hashes justify unchanged text reuse. Exact immutable artifact IDs justify artifact reuse. Actions log reuse requires the same run ID, head SHA, updated_at, run attempt, and a prior successful archive scan. New or changed bodies and successfully downloaded UTF-8 archive members at most 8 MiB were scanned with repository path/email/token rules. Reused resources carry exact IDs and metadata bound to the baseline. Failed downloads and skipped members remain explicit. Release bodies/assets and recognized attachment content were only inventoried; only fingerprints and resource identifiers are retained.

post_collection_redaction_verification.scope: Current PR description bodies only; edit histories are outside inspected coverage.

findings.basis: Review comment explicitly quotes and discusses the verified synthetic policy transport-rejection fixture; exact fingerprint matches the source fixture. No live credential established; no rotation indicated.
